The '''House of Balance''' was a structure on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ehjenla]]. Every [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the ''[[Gaawan]]s'' of all the [[Tuhgri]] tribes gathered at the House of Balance to discuss planetary policy and settle disputes. While present, each tribe was considered to be equal, regardless of military or political standing.
